name: io.agora.rtc.screenshare.utils.firebase.MyFirebaseMessagingService
description: The LiveStoreHub SHAS screen-sharing library handles remote messages that end a session, stops local screen sharing, and shows a session-ended notification. Disabling it can leave sharing active after the remote party ends the session.
disableEffect: A remote session-ending message may no longer stop screen sharing or notify the user.
